name: Hey, Girlie!
source: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim released on May 17, 2025 for International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.
